artboards.title: Late — the bell and its panel

annotations.text:
Four asks — drawn first, then built.

Option B and B1 were chosen; the bell went ahead. Seven commits, 1c276b5..7ac37fc.

One panel changed after measuring: the portfolio jump was not what the first drawing said it was.

B was chosen and is built.

Green keeps meaning good; pale-vs-deep is the move blue already makes between dated and active.
